parsed.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse aisle flanked by tall metal shelving units packed with red plastic crates and boxes. An orange forklift is parked on the right near wooden pallets. The concrete floor extends toward a distant doorway emitting bright light. The ceiling has exposed beams and lights. The space appears organized and industrial.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall metal shelves line both sides of the aisle, filled with red plastic bins and cardboard boxes. They extend into the distance, creating perspective. The left shelf is closer to the camera, partially obscuring the view of the floor behind it. The shelves appear bolted to the wall or floor but are not fully visible.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Numerous red plastic crates are stacked on the shelves, some labeled 'HYDAC'. They are arranged in rows and vary in size. Many are visible on the left shelf, with some appearing empty. They sit directly on the shelf surfaces and are supported by the shelving structure.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange forklift is parked on the right side of the aisle, angled slightly toward the viewer. Its black seat and control levers are visible. It rests on the concrete floor next to wooden pallets. The forklift's front wheels are visible, and its rear is partially obscured by a pallet.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Several wooden pallets are stacked near the forklift on the right. One holds a large wooden crate. Another is positioned further back under the right-hand shelving. They rest directly on the concrete floor and are supported by their own structure.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: The floor is smooth, gray concrete extending from the foreground to the back of the aisle. It is unobstructed except for the pallets and forklift. The floor appears clean and well-maintained, providing a stable base for all objects above it.

objects.label: yellow and black safety cone
objects.observation: A yellow and black striped safety cone is placed at the base of the left shelf, near the bottom edge of the frame. It stands upright on the concrete floor, likely to mark an area or prevent collisions. It is partially obscured by the shelf leg.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: A brightly lit doorway is visible at the far end of the aisle, centered in the background. It emits strong white light, contrasting with the dimmer warehouse interior. The door frame is not clearly defined, but the opening is distinct.
